key_observations: The first Safari run exposed action_verb_jp=分けよ. Initial M48 could not realize an already-imperative verb and failed closed; the raw failure is retained.
After bounded imperative support, the Chinese letter/receipt plan still failed because action_step did not contain its declared object. M48 correctly refused to invent the binding.
Japanese color grouping and English misplaced receipt plans were blocked by M46 nonprogress or task-relabel violations; M48 did not repair them.
The ordinary English blank-report turn was already surface-valid and delivered without M48 changes.
The Japanese report turn had only instruction_missing_visible_stop. M48 preserved the existing object and operation, added a visible stop, and M46 delivered it.

However, the source asked for three headings while the upstream plan and reply changed the target to a heading plus introduction. Same-model M46 review passed this. It is retained as a source-to-plan semantic failure, not a usefulness success.
The final no-method turn stayed outside M48 and M46 and produced Japanese listening.
browser_boundary: One existing Safari test tab was reused. It now shows an offline rendering of the frozen real turn-6 runtime trace; the live isolated server remains on port 7889. No new tab was opened or unrelated tab closed.
claim_boundary: Actual scripted Safari integration evidence, not unseen holdout, blind human judgment, action-quality superiority, or proof of human understanding.
